question: List the 5 most expensive active products by list price.
gold: SELECT product_id, sku, name, list_price FROM analytics_products_public WHERE is_active = true ORDER BY list_price DESC, product_id ASC LIMIT 5

question: How many cancelled orders are there in EU?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cancelled_orders FROM analytics_orders WHERE status = 'cancelled' AND region = 'EU'

question: Show display names and segments of customers created after 2023-06-01, newest first, limit 10.
gold: SELECT display_name, segment, created_at FROM analytics_customers_masked WHERE created_at > '2023-06-01T00:00:00Z' ORDER BY created_at DESC, customer_id ASC LIMIT 10

question: Which products have low stock below 10 units?
gold: SELECT sku, name, stock_qty FROM analytics_products_public WHERE stock_qty < 10 ORDER BY stock_qty ASC, product_id ASC LIMIT 20

question: How many payments were made by each payment method, with totals?
gold: SELECT method, COUNT(*) AS payments, SUM(amount) AS total FROM analytics_payments GROUP BY method ORDER BY total DESC, method ASC

question: How many pending orders are there right now?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) AS pending_orders FROM analytics_orders WHERE status = 'pending'

question: Show the 10 most recent orders with status and region.
gold: SELECT order_id, status, ordered_at, region FROM analytics_orders ORDER BY ordered_at DESC, order_id DESC LIMIT 10

question: List all product categories.
gold: SELECT DISTINCT category_name FROM analytics_products_public ORDER BY category_name ASC

question: What is the overall average review rating and how many reviews exist?
gold: SELECT AVG(rating)::float AS avg_rating, COUNT(*) AS reviews FROM analytics_reviews

question: How many orders were placed in 2025?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders_2025 FROM analytics_orders WHERE ordered_at >= '2025-01-01' AND ordered_at < '2026-01-01'

question: Top 5 categories by revenue in 2025, paid and shipped orders only.
gold: SELECT category_name, SUM(line_revenue) AS revenue FROM analytics_order_lines WHERE status IN ('paid','shipped') AND ordered_at >= '2025-01-01' AND ordered_at < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY category_name ORDER BY revenue DESC, category_name ASC LIMIT 5

question: For each region, show average order value and the share of refunded orders.
gold: WITH o AS (SELECT order_id, region, status, SUM(line_revenue) AS revenue FROM analytics_order_lines GROUP BY order_id, region, status) SELECT region, AVG(CASE WHEN status IN ('paid','shipped') THEN revenue END) AS avg_order_value, SUM(CASE WHEN status='refunded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::float/COUNT(*) AS refunded_share, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM o GROUP BY region ORDER BY region ASC

question: List customers with more than 3 orders and lifetime revenue above $1000.
gold: WITH cust AS (SELECT o.customer_id, COUNT(DISTINCT l.order_id) AS orders, SUM(l.line_revenue) AS revenue FROM analytics_order_lines l JOIN analytics_orders o USING (order_id) WHERE l.status IN ('paid','shipped') GROUP BY o.customer_id) SELECT c.display_name, cust.orders, cust.revenue FROM cust JOIN analytics_customers_masked c USING (customer_id) WHERE cust.orders > 3 AND cust.revenue > 1000 ORDER BY cust.revenue DESC, c.customer_id ASC LIMIT 20

question: Top 5 products by revenue.
gold: SELECT product_id, sku, product_name, SUM(line_revenue) AS revenue FROM analytics_order_lines WHERE status IN ('paid','shipped') GROUP BY product_id, sku, product_name ORDER BY revenue DESC, product_id ASC LIMIT 5

question: What is total revenue by region?
gold: SELECT region, SUM(line_revenue) AS revenue FROM analytics_order_lines WHERE status IN ('paid','shipped') GROUP BY region ORDER BY revenue DESC, region ASC

question: How many orders are there by status?
gold: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM analytics_orders GROUP BY status ORDER BY orders DESC, status ASC

question: How many orders per month in 2025?
gold: SELECT to_char(date_trunc('month', ordered_at),'YYYY-MM') AS month, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM analytics_orders WHERE ordered_at >= '2025-01-01' AND ordered_at < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 ASC

question: Top 5 customers by revenue.
gold: WITH r AS (SELECT o.customer_id, SUM(l.line_revenue) AS revenue FROM analytics_order_lines l JOIN analytics_orders o USING (order_id) WHERE l.status IN ('paid','shipped') GROUP BY o.customer_id) SELECT c.display_name, r.revenue FROM r JOIN analytics_customers_masked c USING (customer_id) ORDER BY r.revenue DESC, c.customer_id ASC LIMIT 5

question: What is the average discount by category?
gold: SELECT category_name, AVG(discount) AS avg_discount FROM analytics_order_lines GROUP BY category_name ORDER BY avg_discount DESC, category_name ASC

question: Compare paid vs shipped revenue.
gold: SELECT status, SUM(line_revenue) AS revenue FROM analytics_order_lines WHERE status IN ('paid','shipped') GROUP BY status ORDER BY status ASC

question: How many customers are in each segment?
gold: SELECT segment, COUNT(*) AS customers FROM analytics_customers_masked GROUP BY segment ORDER BY customers DESC, segment ASC

question: Show revenue by month as a trend.
gold: WITH spine AS (SELECT generate_series(date_trunc('month', min(ordered_at)), date_trunc('month', max(ordered_at)), interval '1 month') AS mon FROM analytics_order_lines WHERE status IN ('paid','shipped')), rev AS (SELECT date_trunc('month', ordered_at) AS mon, SUM(line_revenue) AS revenue FROM analytics_order_lines WHERE status IN ('paid','shipped') GROUP BY 1) SELECT to_char(s.mon,'YYYY-MM') AS month, COALESCE(r.revenue,0) AS revenue FROM spine s LEFT JOIN rev r ON r.mon = s.mon ORDER BY s.mon ASC

question: Top 3 most expensive active products.
gold: SELECT product_id, sku, name, list_price FROM analytics_products_public WHERE is_active = true ORDER BY list_price DESC, product_id ASC LIMIT 3

question: How many cancelled orders are there by region?
gold: SELECT region, COUNT(*) AS cancelled FROM analytics_orders WHERE status = 'cancelled' GROUP BY region ORDER BY cancelled DESC, region ASC

question: Which products were never ordered?
gold: SELECT p.sku, p.name FROM analytics_products_public p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM analytics_order_lines l WHERE l.product_id = p.product_id) ORDER BY p.product_id ASC LIMIT 20

question: Show month-over-month revenue growth percent for 2025, including months with zero revenue.
gold: WITH spine AS (SELECT generate_series('2025-01-01'::timestamptz,'2025-12-01'::timestamptz, interval '1 month') AS mon), rev AS (SELECT date_trunc('month', ordered_at) AS mon, SUM(line_revenue) AS revenue FROM analytics_order_lines WHERE status IN ('paid','shipped') AND ordered_at >= '2025-01-01' AND ordered_at < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY 1) SELECT to_char(s.mon,'YYYY-MM') AS month, COALESCE(r.revenue,0) AS revenue, CASE WHEN LAG(COALESCE(r.revenue,0)) OVER (ORDER BY s.mon) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (COALESCE(r.revenue,0) - LAG(COALESCE(r.revenue,0)) OVER (ORDER BY s.mon)) / NULLIF(LAG(COALESCE(r.revenue,0)) OVER (ORDER BY s.mon),0) END AS mom_growth FROM spine s LEFT JOIN rev r ON r.mon = s.mon ORDER BY s.mon ASC

question: Top product per category by revenue, with rank, excluding categories under $500 total.
gold: WITH cat_rev AS (SELECT category_name, SUM(line_revenue) AS total FROM analytics_order_lines WHERE status IN ('paid','shipped') GROUP BY category_name HAVING SUM(line_revenue) >= 500), prod_rev AS (SELECT l.category_name, l.product_id, l.product_name, SUM(l.line_revenue) AS revenue FROM analytics_order_lines l WHERE l.status IN ('paid','shipped') GROUP BY l.category_name, l.product_id, l.product_name) SELECT p.category_name, p.product_name, p.revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.category_name ORDER BY p.revenue DESC) AS rnk FROM prod_rev p JOIN cat_rev c USING (category_name) ORDER BY p.category_name ASC, rnk ASC

question: Which customers placed their first order in 2024 but ordered nothing after 2025-07-01?
gold: WITH first_o AS (SELECT o.customer_id, MIN(o.ordered_at) AS first_at FROM analytics_orders o GROUP BY o.customer_id), recent AS (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM analytics_orders WHERE ordered_at > '2025-07-01') SELECT c.display_name, first_o.first_at FROM first_o JOIN analytics_customers_masked c USING (customer_id) LEFT JOIN recent USING (customer_id) WHERE first_o.first_at >= '2024-01-01' AND first_o.first_at < '2025-01-01' AND recent.customer_id IS NULL ORDER BY first_o.first_at ASC, c.customer_id ASC LIMIT 20

question: Show running total revenue by month for paid and shipped orders.
gold: WITH m AS (SELECT date_trunc('month', ordered_at) AS mon, SUM(line_revenue) AS revenue FROM analytics_order_lines WHERE status IN ('paid','shipped') GROUP BY 1) SELECT to_char(mon,'YYYY-MM') AS month, revenue, SUM(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY mon ASC) AS running_total FROM m ORDER BY mon ASC

question: Which customers have lifetime revenue above the average lifetime revenue?
gold: WITH cust AS (SELECT o.customer_id, SUM(l.line_revenue) AS revenue FROM analytics_order_lines l JOIN analytics_orders o USING (order_id) WHERE l.status IN ('paid','shipped') GROUP BY o.customer_id), avg_c AS (SELECT AVG(revenue) AS avg_rev FROM cust) SELECT c.display_name, cust.revenue FROM cust JOIN analytics_customers_masked c USING (customer_id), avg_c WHERE cust.revenue > avg_c.avg_rev ORDER BY cust.revenue DESC, c.customer_id ASC LIMIT 20

question: What share of total revenue does each category represent?
gold: WITH t AS (SELECT SUM(line_revenue) AS total FROM analytics_order_lines WHERE status IN ('paid','shipped')), c AS (SELECT category_name, SUM(line_revenue) AS revenue FROM analytics_order_lines WHERE status IN ('paid','shipped') GROUP BY category_name) SELECT c.category_name, c.revenue, c.revenue / t.total AS share FROM c, t ORDER BY share DESC, c.category_name ASC

question: What is the median order value across paid and shipped orders?
gold: WITH o AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(line_revenue) AS revenue FROM analytics_order_lines WHERE status IN ('paid','shipped') GROUP BY order_id) SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY revenue)::float AS median_order_value FROM o

question: Which orders contain lines from more than 2 distinct categories?
gold: SELECT order_id, COUNT(DISTINCT category_name) AS categories, SUM(line_revenue) AS revenue FROM analytics_order_lines GROUP BY order_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT category_name) > 2 ORDER BY categories DESC, order_id ASC LIMIT 20

question: Which products are priced above their category average list price?
gold: WITH avg_c AS (SELECT category_name, AVG(list_price) AS avg_price FROM analytics_products_public GROUP BY category_name) SELECT p.sku, p.name, p.category_name, p.list_price FROM analytics_products_public p JOIN avg_c USING (category_name) WHERE p.list_price > avg_c.avg_price ORDER BY p.list_price DESC, p.product_id ASC LIMIT 20

question: What share of customers placed more than one paid or shipped order?
gold: WITH c AS (SELECT o.customer_id, COUNT(DISTINCT l.order_id) AS orders FROM analytics_order_lines l JOIN analytics_orders o USING (order_id) WHERE l.status IN ('paid','shipped') GROUP BY o.customer_id) SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN orders > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::float / COUNT(*) AS repeat_share, COUNT(*) AS customers FROM c
